text: The Vista AF Corse team name and livery carry the Vista brand of Vista Global Holding Limited ('Vista'), the Dubai-headquartered private aviation group whose services are offered through its leading brands, including VistaJet and XO.
short: 'Vista' is Vista Global Holding Limited, the group behind the Vista AF Corse name and livery; VistaJet and XO are its brands.

source.name: PR Newswire (release by Vista) – Vista AF Corse showcases its striking FIA world ensurance championship livery, as battle gears up for Le Mans
source.quote: Vista Global Holding Limited (Vista) is the world's leading global business aviation company
source.note: The same release's About Vista section also says its services are 'offered through its leading brands, including VistaJet and XO'.
